notes: This selector does not deploy a cron job, prepare artwork, or find licensed recordings.
Restore a prepared bundle, backdrop, final motion review and retained receipt into private local paths before checking readiness.
Prepared archives and immutable receipt versions belong only in the dedicated private GitHub draft release; never publish that draft.
Verify anonymous draft API access returns404 in the actual GitHub runner before enabling scheduled execution.
Filebin is temporary delivery, not a persistent two-week source-media queue.
A delayed attempt may retry the same local date, but it must report a missed 18:00 deadline truthfully.
